newsitem.title: USA: Government Technology not meeting loan covenants.
newsitem.headline: Government Technology not meeting loan covenants.

text.p: Government Technology Services Inc said Thursday that as of May 1, it continued to be out of compliance with certain 1996 year-end financial covenants under its existing loan agreement.
The company said that it and its agent bank are currently negotiating the terms and conditions of an amendment to its existing loan agreement, which is expected to be executed by June 2.
GTSI is a reseller of computer products and services to federal, state and local governments.
